test_sequence_observation: A reboot during the stock-boot rollback leg left Decode refresh-session unconfirmed. Its existing guard withdrew that selection at re-enable. firmware_policy: Firmware components strictly pinned; supported per-user root packaging differences allowed; personal original/candidate identity and foreign-boot write guards retained
frameguard: Omitted from new release; historical assets retained in old release
private_material_scan: Passed tracked-source and all four package scans; no per-user images, endpoints, logs or signing keys
source_archive: Git-tracked release commit only; excludes local AGENTS.md, dist/private work, firmware, keys and proprietary blobs
limitations: Only matched target boot lifecycle physically tested
Other supported root-packaging variants checked offline/in fixtures
New private boot/profile required for the new keeper; no silent existing-store migration
Foreign boot changes after activation block full-image rollback
No new sustained game performance, HDR calibration or physical HDMI-blackout claim
